image_description: A close-up, slightly grainy photograph featuring a person in the background (right side) looking towards the camera, partially obscured by large, translucent soap bubbles in the foreground. The bubbles exhibit strong iridescence with swirling pink, blue, and green patterns. One prominent bubble on the left shows a distinct blue ring reflection. The background appears to be a tiled bathroom wall.
